concerns: Initial SPEC search also returned the T3o row because it referenced T3m; only T3l/T3m were used for the package.
Footprints are the required 60×40 placeholders; shaped footprints remain conductor work.
Shadow ratio also responds to object colour and other BEFORE/AFTER changes; no object exclusion was requested.
Large central and right-hand trees connect under the required grouping rule and are packaged together as west_obj_02_c; they are not independently reusable.

conventions.matte: frozen extract(edge_mode=clamp, preserve_particles=True); retain detached groups for STEP 3
conventions.resize: Pillow RGBa premultiplied LANCZOS to crop_box dimensions
conventions.registration: mean absolute RGB channel error over alpha >= 200; integer dx,dy in [-10,10]; ties prefer shortest shift
conventions.shift_flag: Euclidean shift magnitude > 3 or RGB residual > 22
conventions.grouping: Euclidean disk radius 3 dilation; 8-connected groups; counts and border-touch test use original alpha >= 32 support, not added dilation pixels
conventions.anchor: x mean of opaque pixel centres in bottom six occupied rows; y lowest opaque row + 1
conventions.shadow: Rec.709 luminance on 0..255 RGB; scipy Gaussian sigma 11 px before ratio; threshold then Gaussian sigma 2 px
conventions.output_scope: Receipt covers authored deliverables, excluding live wrapper-owned dotfiles

panel_order: BEFORE × (1 − s) + assets sorted by anchor y
